csv_project_name: Dev for Upstate New York Nuclear Power Plant - 1 GW
csv_scope_of_work: NYPA is issuing this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to identify a set of developers qualified to deliver an advanced nuclear generation project across two possible technology pathways: a large-scale reactor (LSR), such as the AP1000, and/or a small modular reactor (SMR), such as the BWRX-300. NYPA will consider both nth-of-a-kind (NOAK) Generation III+ or Generation IV technologies provided that a first-of-a-kind project (either by the respondent or by another owner/developer) must be at or beyond First Nuclear Concrete by early 2030. The selected pathway must demonstrate a credible path to both produce 1+ GW of energy and start construction before 2033 to ensure Inflation Reduction Act Investment Tax Credit eligibility. First-of-a-kind (FOAK) and micro modular reactors (MMRs) are outside the scope of this project.
